test_title: PYST 38: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A right circular cone is 6.7 cm high, and the radius of its base is 17.6 cm. It is melted and recast into a new right circular cone with a base radius of 8.8 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the new cone.
solution:
**Given:**

Height of the original cone (h₁) = 6.7 cm

Radius of the base of the original cone (r₁) = 17.6 cm

Radius of the base of the new cone (r₂) = 8.8 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Calculation:

Since the cones are melted and recast, the volumes remain equal:

(1)/(3) pi r₁² h₁ = (1)/(3) pi r₂² h₂

⇒ r₁² × h₁ = r₂² × h₂

⇒ h₂ = (r₁² × h₁) / r₂²

h₂ = (17.6² × 6.7) / 8.8²

⇒ h₂ = (309.76 × 6.7) / 77.44

⇒ h₂ = 2075.392 / 77.44

⇒ h₂ = 26.8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
